[[Grawl Invader]]s can be found in Green Hills County, harassing travelers on the road to [[Lakeside County]]. Vanquishing them is the objective of the quest [[Grawl Invasion]].

==Locations==
*[[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]]
**{{NPC location|Green Hills County}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Grawl Longspear Gear]]
*[[Grawl Necklace]]

==Notes==
*Unlike most other level 1 [[creature]]s, Grawl Invaders have 80 [[health]].

==Trivia==
*They are for all intents and purposes identical to normal [[Grawl (pre-Searing)|Grawl]], even in their appearance.

{{Anomaly|Grawl Invaders are always present in the area, even before picking up the quest [[Grawl Invasion]] and after completion too.}}
